description:
Manage quotes within a collection: add, remove, list, or public_list. Auth required for add/remove/list. public_list is unauthenticated.

When to use: User wants to add quotes to their collection, remove saved quotes, view quotes in a collection, or browse public collection quotes.

Examples:
- `collection_quotes(action="add", collection="favorites", quote="abc123")` - add quote
- `collection_quotes(action="list", collection="favorites")` - list quotes in collection
- `collection_quotes(action="public_list", username="curator", slug="favorites")` - view public collection quotes
- `collection_quotes(action="public_list", token="abc123")` - view shared collection quotes

about.description: Semantic search within collection (e.g., 'courage'); requires a single named collection (not collection='all' — use quotes_about for global search)

action.description: Quote operation: add, remove, list, or public_list

circumstance.description: Per-collection circumstance override (used with add action)

collection.description: Collection name/slug identifier. Use 'all' to search across all collections (not combinable with 'about' — semantic search requires a single named collection).

anyOf.description:
MPAA-style content rating for quotes.

Values match database content_rating field values exactly.
Member names follow Django TextChoices convention (no underscores).

Compatible with Django TextChoices API:
- .label: Human-readable label (e.g., "General Audience")
- .choices: List of (value, label) tuples for model fields

content_rating.description: Filter quotes by maximum MPAA-style content rating. Cumulative: requesting 'PG' includes G and PG content.

framing.description: Curator editorial framing for the quote (used with add action)

gender.description: Filter by originator gender. Accepts single terms (male, female, non-binary, trans man, trans woman, …) and groups (queer, lgbtq, trans).

length.description: Filter quotes by word-count category: brief (≤15 words), short (≤35 words), medium (36–100 words), long (101–200 words), or passage (201+ words).

living.description: Filter quotes by originator living status (living/alive vs deceased/historical).

notes.description: Private notes for the quote (used with add action)

quote.description: Quote short_code or ID (required for add/remove actions)

reading_level.description: Filter quotes by reading level (elementary/middle_school/high_school/college). Supported languages: en, es, fr, de, it, nl, ru, pt. Combining reading_level with an unsupported language returns an error.

name: collection_quotes
title: Manage quotes in collections
